webhooks.name: cognitive-brain-ci-feedback
webhooks.description: Notifies the Cognitive Brain API server of CI outcomes in real-time. Feeds workflow_run, pull_request and issue_comment events into the brain memory layer.
webhooks.notes: URL is a placeholder. Set to active=true and update URL once the Cognitive Brain API server is deployed. Secret is sourced from WEBHOOK_SECRET org secret.

webhooks.name: runner-health-notification
webhooks.description: Notifies Cognitive Brain when copilot-setup-steps completes so it can record runner_adequate output and auto-adjust COPILOT_RUNNER_PROFILE for subsequent sessions.
webhooks.notes: Shares endpoint with cognitive-brain-ci-feedback. Activate alongside that hook. Provides AAIS autonomous runner-selection feedback loop closure (W-121/W-122).
